top_categories.workout_context: Granfondo Laigueglia's mixed terrain forces constant power changes. Accelerate over rises and out of corners, settle on the open road, and repeat for 69 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Laigueglia's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
69 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
80ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
At Granfondo Laigueglia, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
5,577ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Laigueglia. Train it until it feels boring.
5,577ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Granfondo Laigueglia, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on mixed terrain. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Base fitness for Granfondo Laigueglia. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
Low-cadence force work for 5,577ft of climbing. The slow, grinding ascents where you can't spin—you push.

race_overlay.heat: February in Laigueglia, Liguria, Italy can bring heat. Complete 3–4 heat exposure sessions in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Laigueglia. Increase sodium intake 48 hours before race day.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Granfondo Laigueglia’s 69 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Granfondo Laigueglia requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Road Specific, Race Simulation, and Durability to prepare you for 69 miles of mixed terrain in Laigueglia, Liguria, Italy.
